title: Miners Memorial Park Campground

services.name: Group Campground
services.desc: Are you planning a family reunion, wedding, youth campout, or team getaway? This quiet outdoor space in the heart of Miners Park can offer your group a one-of-a-kind rental experience unlike anything else in southern Alberta. It's a great space for gathering and has several amenities: In addition to the campground, this area provides access to a nearby playground, soccer fields, ball diamonds, and a rentable private social area that has a full kitchen, gas BBQs, larger picnic shelter and green space.
